$comment: Contract for Hub to Node on-demand configuration projection via POST /api/node/config

200.description: Initial activation or configuration changed since ETag

payload.search_providers: object (keyed by search provider id, omitted/empty when filtered out)

304.description: Not Modified. Zero byte payload. Node extends lease in-memory.

401.description: Node revoked, disabled, or invalid token. Node must immediately call PurgeSecrets() and stop serving.

invariants.physical_zero_leak: No provider, search_provider, or key with origin='local' may ever appear in the projected payload.
invariants.scope_isolation: Only providers listed in node.scope.providers, models listed in node.scope.models, and search_providers listed in node.scope.search_providers may appear in the payload.
invariants.zero_disk: Lite nodes must hold the payload in-memory (atomic.Pointer) and never persist to disk.
